main_measure.name: mean 20-bar fwd return on forecast>0 blocks minus mean over all blocks

supporting_check.name: share of up-crosses with positive 20-bar return vs unconditional share (1.0 vs 0.5639344262295082; mean after cross 0.20385257859389416)

decided_by: Fewer than the minimum counts (13 in-position blocks vs 15 needed, 2 up-crosses vs 8 needed), so the test neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: Non-overlapping blocks start at each window's first bar every 20 bars, a block is in-position when forecast > 0 at its start bar, t is the difference divided by the standard error of the in-position block returns, an up-cross is forecast <= 0 on the prior bar and > 0 on the bar, and the unconditional share uses the 20-bar forward returns of every bar in the windows.
